entities.name: Angélique Duchemin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Angélique Duchemin was a French professional boxer known as "La princesse des rings", who competed between 2012 and 2017. She won all 14 of her professional fights, including three by knockout, and became the World Boxing Federation featherweight champion by defeating Ericka Rousseau in 2017.
